prompt: Who is the only female artist to have topped Spotify's list of most-streamed artists in three consecutive years (2020–2022)?
answer: None. **Bad Bunny** topped Spotify’s most-streamed artist list from **2020–2022**; the only female artist to top the list is **Taylor Swift**, in **2023 and 2024**.
